fixture.desktop: Wayland with exact XWayland vendor window
fixture.processing: pre-existing C3 loop and Macro 1 automation; no new DSP instance

finding.boundary: X11 delivery to Wine/Win32 hardware mouse admission, before WH_MOUSE and PeekMessage retrieval
finding.classification: input admission delay, not a demonstrated renderer defect
finding.clock_interpretation: at least this much delay after X11 was observed; the actual X11 event occurred no later than that observation
finding.after_observation: retained GUI history later contained Value 0.6800000071525574 and End for the same logical view/epoch; editor closed normally
finding.page_click: correct X11 target and coordinates; no Win32 page button within observation; navigation hash unchanged; requested page appeared later outside bounded timing record

interpretation: X11 receipt excludes absence of Deck mouse input for these actions.
Correct client coordinates and HTCLIENT child selection exclude the original stale-warp harness error in the refined and human runs.
The delivered mouse-down reached the vendor child and downstream hook chain returned zero; our observer did not consume it.
Heartbeats continued while hardware input was delayed for seconds. This is not a continuous eight-second UI-thread deadlock.
The production pump uses unfiltered PeekMessage(nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE); no message filter was changed.
A Moonlight input comparison reproduced the delayed boundary, so the observation is not specific to XTEST injection.
Local exact-window page pixels also remained unchanged during the wait; Moonlight-only display latency does not explain this record.
Wine hardware-input/focus/queue admission and vendor interactions with that path remain candidates; no internal Wine function or rendering repair is selected.
limits: Diagnostic-on observation is not product latency or audio performance qualification.
WH_GETMESSAGE records posted-message retrieval; WH_CALLWNDPROC/RET covers sent-message calls, not arbitrary posted WndProc execution time.
GUI events are observed at poll time, not synchronized vendor emission time.
Host parameter updates were already replaying. Their projection is instance-scoped; Begin/Value/End remain editor-scoped.
Macro visual region was calibrated on FX. The later human comparison began on Play, so it has no valid macro redraw-latency claim.
UIA returned no census because the bounded probe failed; this does not prove canvas-only semantics.
Only the X11/XWayland adapter is implemented and exercised. Native Wayland has a fail-closed portal/EIS boundary, not a completed injection backend.
Loaded OpenGL modules are observed; presenting API/thread, GPU frame time and compositor latency were not measured.
No general UI map, OCR, graphics optimization, raw keyboard text, account inspection or full AP18 campaign.
